name: Name
clientsOwnSpace: Clients see only their own space
dangerBody: Transferring changes who can bill and manage members. Deleting removes its spaces, tasks and channels; reports arriving through its integrations stop being accepted.
onlySuperadminDeletes: Only a platform superadmin can delete an organization
keyShownOnce: This is the only time this key is shown. Save it now.
keyHashOnly: The server keeps a hash of it and nothing else, so it cannot be read back — losing it means rotating and updating whatever was using it.
integrationNamePlaceholder: Name — the client or system this is for
noOriginChecked: No origin is checked — a server sends none. The key is the whole of it.
nothingWired: Nothing is wired to this organization yet.
rotateBody: Whatever is using the old key stops being able to post the moment this happens. You get the new one once.
deleteIntegrationBody: Its channel stops accepting anything. Work already raised through it stays where it is.
revokeBody: They will no longer be able to accept it.
inviteExplain: <1>Add directly</1> only works for people already in another organization you administer. Everyone else gets an <3>Invite</3>: a request they accept from their own app — no email needed.
meetingsExplain: A meeting reminder rings. At the time you set, everyone in the organization gets a card with a sound — like a call — and a button to join the room if you pick one. The time is kept as a time of day in a zone, so it stays at that hour when the clocks change.
nothingScheduled: Nothing scheduled. A reminder is for the meetings that repeat — the daily, the weekly review — so nobody has to remember them.
pickADay: Pick a day, or it would never come round.
lastDayNote: In shorter months it rings on the last day.
deleteMeetingBody: It stops ringing. Nothing else is affected.
everyoneByDefault: Everyone is included by default, and anyone who joins the organization later is too. Unticking someone is what gets remembered.
lead: Each integration receives reports from an external system, server to server: it holds an ingest key and sends no Origin, so the key is the whole of it. The key is shown once — when it is created, and when it is rotated.
shownOnceShort: shown once, when created or rotated
originNotChecked: not checked; a server sends none. The key is the whole of it.
nowhereLost: nowhere — anything it sends is being lost
timeDoesNotExist: That time doesn't exist that day because of the clock change
doneNeedsSubtasks: Finish subtasks before marking a task done

github.lead: Repos linked to a space link their branches, PRs and commits to the task they name: they show under “Development”, and opening and merging a PR leaves a line in the thread. The lines are internal: the client doesn't see them.
github.syntax: To name a task: cac#12 (the space's number) or the client's folio, like acme-7, in the message, the PR title or the branch name (cac-12-login, feature/acme-7-fix).
github.notConfigured: This cac server doesn't have the GitHub App configured.
github.noInstallations: No GitHub account has the App installed for this organization.
github.finishInBrowser: Finish the install in the browser and come back here.
github.bareRefsHint: Let #12 without «cac» name task 12 too. On GitHub, #12 is the repo's issue 12.
github.unboundTitle: Installed on GitHub, with no organization in cac
github.unboundLead: GitHub didn't tell cac which organization they were for: it happens when an owner approves it from GitHub. Only you see this, as a superadmin.
github.adoptBody: Its repos ({{repos}}) join this organization, ready to link to a space. Once linked, no other organization can take it.
github.adopted: {{account}} is now linked to this organization

basecamp.lead: Connect your organization's Basecamp account: comments, messages and completed to-dos of the projects you link to a space reach cac as notices, and a mention in Basecamp notifies that person here.
basecamp.notConfigured: This cac server doesn't have Basecamp set up yet (it needs the 37signals app's credentials). There is nothing to connect until it does.
basecamp.notConnected: No Basecamp account is connected to this organization.
basecamp.reconnectNeeded: Basecamp stopped renewing the permission, so nothing is arriving. Connect again: the projects you linked are kept.
basecamp.finishInBrowser: Authorize cac in the browser and come back here: this page reads Basecamp again when you do.
basecamp.disconnectBody: cac removes its webhooks from Basecamp and forgets the linked projects. The people you matched stay, and nothing in Basecamp is deleted.
basecamp.projectsLead: Each Basecamp project you link to a space leaves its activity on the tasks linked to it, and a notice for everything else. One that isn't linked does nothing.
basecamp.projectsNone: This Basecamp account has no projects.
basecamp.webhookMissing: Linked, but Basecamp didn't register the webhook: nothing arrives from this project
basecamp.linked: {{project}} is linked to {{space}}: Basecamp will send its activity here
basecamp.linkedNoWebhook: {{project}} is linked to {{space}}, but the webhook wasn't registered: nothing will arrive from it
basecamp.peopleLead: cac matches people by email. These weren't found among the members of this organization: assign each one to a member so their mentions notify them.
basecamp.peopleNone: Everyone in Basecamp is matched to a member.

teamZoneHint: Meetings are created in it; everyone sees them in their own time.
notTeamZone: Not in the team time zone ({{city}}): edit it if it should be.
inviteInstead: @{{who}} isn't in any of your organizations, so we sent them an invitation.

spaceAccess.partly: a client sees part of it

removeBody: They will lose access to {{org}} and its resources.
rolesExplain: admin manages · member writes · viewer only reads
guestsNotListed: Guests are not listed here: they reach DevTools and nothing else, and they do not belong to the organization.
badZone: That is not a time zone. Write it like America/Mexico_City, or leave it empty.
joinedRenew: Joined {{name}}. Sign out and back in to finish getting access.
